assets.prompt: Abstract light-and-material study, macro photograph, for a dark cinematic website section background: no product, no hero object, no people. A single narrow beam of warm amber light enters from the upper left and passes through a thick slab of optical glass with a chamfered edge, breaking into soft caustic ribbons that spill across a matte near-black surface in the right half of the frame. Fine dust drifts through volumetric haze. Large empty dark space on the left for the headline, and a calm low-contrast centre because a device mockup sits on top of it. 85mm macro at f/4, shallow focus falling off into the corners, fine film grain, gently lifted blacks, no vignette.
